newsitem.title: USA: MTD WITHDRAWS OFFER FOR ALL SHILOH SHARES.
newsitem.headline: MTD WITHDRAWS OFFER FOR ALL SHILOH SHARES.

text.p: Shiloh Industries Inc said Wednesday that MTD Products Inc has withdrawn its offer to acquire all the shares of Shiloh it does not already own. MTD currently owns 36 percent of the company.

Shiloh also said that in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, MTD has offered to purchase 27.8 percent of Shiloh's shares, owned by Dominick Fanello and James Fanello, for $19.00 per share.

The company said if the transaction is completed, MTD will own 64 percent of its shares. But Shiloh added that the transaction is still subject to review and no agreement between the parties is assured.
Shiloh Industries is a supplier of steel blanks, stampings and processed steel to automotive, appliance and other industrial manufacturers.
